name: qb_ml_compact_2026
kind: DHQ stand-alone QB model (qb-ml): component LightGBM (linear trees) -> half-PPR; no Sleeper input
trained_on: posted starting QBs, regular season 2013-2025 (nflverse); shift/calibration from rolling out-of-sample rows 2021-2025
usage: raw_c = mean over boosters of link(sum of tree outputs); mean_raw = sum_c w_c*raw_c; pred (typical/median) = mean_raw + median_shift; E_c = raw_c*mult (ryd: + add); pred_mean = sum_c w_c*E_c
